_readme: APPROVED COMMENTS ONLY. Nothing here is automatic.
A visitor's comment arrives in Amit's email. It becomes public only when it
is added to the 'comments' array below and the change is pushed to GitHub.
Add a new entry at the top or bottom — the site sorts by date, newest first.
"company":   "Optional. Shown next to the name in grey.",
"reply":     "Optional. Your public reply, shown indented under it.",
"approved":  "Optional. Set false to hide without deleting the entry."
Never paste an email address, phone number or anything else private into a
comment — every field here is public the moment it is pushed.
